overview: A family history app for the Norwood family with profile claiming, family tree exploration, archives, stories, recipes, messaging, governance, and a new Historical Research Intake workspace for documenting proposed findings with sources and evidence.
features: Claim and manage family member profiles
Explore the family tree and heritage branches
Browse family archive, stories, mysteries, and timeline
Family Steward governance and pending contributions
Historical Research Intake with sources, proposed findings, and conflict review
